scope.operation: exact replay of a higher-nullity algebraic fiber candidate in the rational-Bezier parallel contact kernel
scope.new_case: a selected root of the specialized fiber GCD whose multiplicity is even, so its endpoint signs do not change
scope.canonical_fixture: alpha=cuberoot(1/2), beta=alpha^2=cuberoot(1/4), with a specialized fiber proportional to (beta-alpha^2)^2

mathematical_contract.field: the fiber is counted over the exact local algebraic field Q(alpha), represented by rational-polynomial fractions reduced modulo the retained root's defining polynomial
mathematical_contract.root_counter: a square-free local-field Sturm sequence counts distinct roots in the candidate isolator, including roots of even multiplicity
mathematical_contract.reducible_definitions: the defining polynomial need not be irreducible; exact isolator evidence selects the intended real root and tests cover a reducible carrier
mathematical_contract.endpoint_contract: exact endpoint roots are counted once and open-interval variations count the remaining roots
mathematical_contract.acceptance: zero counted roots rejects the pair, one or more counted roots accepts it, and unsupported arithmetic remains explicit uncertainty
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact identities, rational arithmetic, certified algebraic-root refinement, and exact Sturm variation only
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph and may approximate only an unresolved inherited sign/equality at Hyperlimit's 512-bit terminal
mathematical_contract.unsupported: non-rational bivariate coefficients, invalid isolator evidence, specialized degree drops, and positive-dimensional shared components remain explicit rather than guessed
mathematical_contract.no_predicates_build: without the optional predicate backend Hypercurve preserves explicit Incomplete/Predicate uncertainty; it never substitutes a floating contact

completion_change.before: an even-multiplicity higher-nullity fiber could survive candidate projection but remained Incomplete because neither direct substitution nor endpoint sign change certified it
completion_change.after: the coupled even-multiplicity pair is certified Direct under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512
completion_change.guards: zero-root, repeated-root, multi-root, rational-witness, endpoint-root, invalid-evidence, unsupported-coefficient, both-orientation, and both-policy cases are tested

matched_local_sturm_benchmark.method: seven interleaved pinned-core release samples, 1000 root counts per process, identical benchmark source and current dependency revisions
matched_local_sturm_benchmark.checksum: one distinct root per iteration at both revisions

native_hypercurve_release_benchmark.method: five pinned-core all-feature release processes; the existing lanes do not trigger local Sturm after their earlier exact certificates, so they are retained as end-to-end non-regression sentinels rather than measurements of the new cold path

aggregate_heaptrack.interpretation: allocation counts are identical to the preceding higher-nullity checkpoint because every benchmark lane exits before the new local-Sturm fallback

all_feature_hypercurve_offset_executable.interpretation: the linked all-feature cost includes the reusable exact local-field arithmetic; the focused optimized executable adds under 0.2 percent text over its correctness-first baseline

static_call_graph.caveat: the utility is a static source approximation and these default scans exclude benchmark-only functions
